learnings: `TracebackException`, notes, causes and exception groups turn a crash into a structured report.
`sys.excepthook` and `threading.excepthook` catch uncaught errors in every thread.
`sys.settrace` and `bdb.Bdb` are enough to build a call tracer and a watchpoint debugger.
pitfalls: Local variables in crash reports leak secrets unless names such as `token` or `password` are redacted, even inside dicts.
